newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - No Danish rate cut despite strong crown.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - No Danish rate cut despite strong crown.

text.p: Economists at Denmark's BG bank see no immediate prospect of central bank interest rate cuts, even though the crown currency is buoyant, the current issue of the bank's Finansbrevet says.
"Despite the marked strength of the crown to the mark we do not expect any alteration of rates from the National Bank," the weekly newsletter of Denmark's third-largest bank said.
It added that it saw GDP growth in 1996 and 1997 as among the strongest in Europe -- it was 2.7 percent in the third quarter of 1996 -- while inflation remained moderate.
